name: Are solar panels required for green building certification?

mainEntity.name: Are solar panels required for green building certification?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, but on-site renewable energy contributes points toward certifications like LEED, NGBS, or Green Globes, often offsetting 20-100% of annual energy use. inogenalliance+1
